Summary

CBTRN01C is a batch COBOL program in the CardDemo application that reads daily transaction records sequentially and validates each transaction by cross-referencing the card number against a cross-reference file to retrieve the associated account, then looks up the account details in the account file. It serves as a transaction posting driver, opening all required reference files at startup, processing each daily transaction record, and closing all files upon completion.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM (Indexed and Sequential Files) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Open all required files (Daily Transaction File, Customer File, Card Cross-Reference File, Card File, Account File, and Transaction File) before processing begins 2: Daily Transaction Record Reading - Sequentially read each transaction record from the Daily Transaction File one at a time until all records are processed 3: Transaction Display - Display the details of each successfully read daily transaction record for visibility and audit purposes 4: Card Number Cross-Reference Lookup - For each transaction, use the card number from the daily transaction to look up the corresponding Account ID and Customer ID from the Card Cross-Reference File 5: Card Number Validation - Verify that the card number from the daily transaction exists in the Cross-Reference File; if not found, log a message indicating the card could not be verified and skip the transaction 6: Account Record Retrieval - Using the Account ID obtained from the Cross-Reference lookup, retrieve the corresponding account details from the Account File 7: Account Validation - Verify that the account associated with the transaction exists in the Account File; if not found, display a message indicating the account was not found 8: Transaction Skipping - When a card number cannot be verified in the Cross-Reference File, skip the current transaction and log the transaction ID that was skipped 9: End-of-File Detection - Detect when all daily transaction records have been read and stop the transaction processing loop 10: Program Finalization - Close all opened files (Daily Transaction File, Customer File, Card Cross-Reference File, Card File, Account File, and Transaction File) after all transactions have been processed

Datasource Information (6)

Datasource Name Type Usage
DALYTRAN-FILE SEQUENTIAL Input - Reads daily transaction records sequentially for processing
XREF-FILE INDEXED (VSAM KSDS) Input - Looks up card number to retrieve associated account ID and customer ID
ACCOUNT-FILE INDEXED (VSAM KSDS) Input - Reads account details using the account ID retrieved from the cross-reference file
CUSTOMER-FILE INDEXED (VSAM KSDS) Input - Opened for reference but not actively read during transaction processing in current code
CARD-FILE INDEXED (VSAM KSDS) Input - Opened for reference but not actively read during transaction processing in current code
TRANSACT-FILE INDEXED (VSAM KSDS) Input - Opened for reference but not actively read during transaction processing in current code

High level flow diagram

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Sequential Processing of All Daily Transactions-L1000: ```cobol 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT. READ DALYTRAN-FILE INTO DALYTRAN-RECORD. IF DALYTRAN-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ``` End-of-File Detection on Daily Transaction File-L1000: ```cobol IF DALYTRAN-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ... IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-DAILY-TRANS-FILE ``` Display of Each Transaction Record Upon Successful Read-LMAIN: ```cobol IF END-OF-DAILY-TRANS-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT IF END-OF-DAILY-TRANS-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD END-IF ``` Card Number Verification via Cross-Reference File-L2000: ```cobol 2000-LOOKUP-XREF. MOVE XREF-CARD-NUM TO FD-XREF-CARD-NUM READ XREF-FILE RECORD INTO CARD-XREF-RECORD KEY IS FD-XREF-CARD-NUM INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOR XREF' MOVE 4 TO WS-XREF-READ-STATUS NOT INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'SUCCESSFUL READ OF XREF' DISPLAY 'CARD NUMBER: ' XREF-CARD-NUM DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT ID : ' XREF-ACCT-ID DISPLAY 'CUSTOMER ID: ' XREF-CUST-ID END-READ. ``` Transaction Skipped When Card Number Cannot Be Verified-LMAIN: ```cobol IF WS-XREF-READ-STATUS = 0 ... ELSE DISPLAY 'CARD NUMBER ' DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM ' COULD NOT BE VERIFIED. SKIPPING TRANSACTION ID-' DALYTRAN-ID END-IF ``` Account Record Retrieval Using Account ID from Cross-Reference-L3000: ```cobol 3000-READ-ACCOUNT. MOVE ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID READ ACCOUNT-FILE RECORD INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD KEY IS FD-ACCT-ID NOT INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'SUCCESSFUL READ OF ACCOUNT FILE' END-READ. ``` Account Not Found Warning After Verified Card Lookup-LMAIN_L3000: ```cobol IF WS-XREF-READ-STATUS = 0 MOVE 0 TO WS-ACCT-READ-STATUS MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO ACCT-ID PERFORM 3000-READ-ACCOUNT IF WS-ACCT-READ-STATUS NOT = 0 DISPLAY 'ACCOUNT ' ACCT-ID ' NOT FOUND' END-IF ``` ```cobol 3000-READ-ACCOUNT. ... INVALID KEY DISPLAY 'INVALID ACCOUNT NUMBER FOUND' MOVE 4 TO WS-ACCT-READ-STATUS ``` Program Initialization - Open All Required Files-L0000_L0500: ```cobol PERFORM 0000-DALYTRAN-OPEN. PERFORM 0100-CUSTFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0200-XREFFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0300-CARDFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0500-TRANFILE-OPEN. ``` Program Finalization - Close All Files After Processing-L9000_L9500: ```cobol PERFORM 9000-DALYTRAN-CLOSE. PERFORM 9100-CUSTFILE-CLOSE. PERFORM 9200-XREFFILE-CLOSE. PERFORM 9300-CARDFILE-CLOSE. PERFORM 9400-ACCTFILE-CLOSE. PERFORM 9500-TRANFILE-CLOSE. ```

1: Program Initialization

Business Rules

Supporting Code

Daily Transaction File Must Be Available at Program Start-L_0000: ```cobol 0000-DALYTRAN-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT DALYTRAN-FILE IF DALYTRAN-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING DAILY TRANSACTION FILE' MOVE DALYTRAN-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Customer File Must Be Available at Program Start-L_0100: ```cobol 0100-CUSTFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT CUSTOMER-FILE IF CUSTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CUSTOMER FILE' MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Card Cross-Reference File Must Be Available at Program Start-L_0200: ```cobol 0200-XREFFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT XREF-FILE IF XREFFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CROSS REF FILE' MOVE XREFFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Card File Must Be Available at Program Start-L_0300: ```cobol 0300-CARDFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT CARD-FILE IF CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CARD FILE' MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Account File Must Be Available at Program Start-L_0400: ```cobol 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT ACCOUNT-FILE IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING ACCOUNT FILE' MOVE ACCTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` Transaction File Must Be Available at Program Start-L_0500: ```cobol 0500-TRANFILE-OPEN. MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT. OPEN INPUT TRANSACT-FILE IF TRANFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT END-IF IF APPL-AOK CONTINUE ELSE DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING TRANSACTION FILE' MOVE TRANFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS PERFORM Z-ABEND-PROGRAM END-IF ``` All Required Files Must Be Successfully Opened Before Transaction Processing Begins-L_MAIN: ```cobol PERFORM 0000-DALYTRAN-OPEN. PERFORM 0100-CUSTFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0200-XREFFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0300-CARDFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN. PERFORM 0500-TRANFILE-OPEN. PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-DAILY-TRANS-FILE = 'Y' ```

SKIPPING TRANSACTION ID-' DALYTRAN-ID END-IF ``` Continue to Account Processing When Card Is Successfully Verified-L_MAIN-PARA & 2000-LOOKUP-XREF: ```cobol IF WS-XREF-READ-STATUS = 0 MOVE 0 TO WS-ACCT-READ-STATUS MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO ACCT-ID PERFORM 3000-READ-ACCOUNT ```
